stop_policy: Continue after navigation failure; stop on runtime/inference/contract failure. Six exclusive IDs, no retries, no positive-delay sweep.
progress_selection: Precontact observation and application; east of original exit plane; measured northbound approach. Per-bin median w and native lookahead-left; representative observation closest to bin midpoint, ties by request ID. Record actual XY/yaw differences; bins are not identical views or states.
divergence_rule: First two adjacent occupied common Y bins with different signs of BOTH median applied w and median native lookahead-left, using unchanged hospital_validation numerical sign tolerances. Descriptive persistent steering divergence, not causal onset, significance or hard-case threshold.
bootstrap_rule: Compare saved first RGB pixels, observation pose, native arrays, commands, timing, history and reasoning. Numeric/hash inequality is not automatically meaningful divergence.
timing_note: Response-detection-to-application monotonic duration is an upper-bound diagnostic including validation/controller/application/logging; not exact hook cost. Action ready and reasoning completion poll are different events. No exact KV tensor identity or worker-ready timestamp is inferred.
matching_note: No cross-run equal-C-index physical correspondence; C12..C18 is a separately labeled descriptive appendix. Native local curves are shown in their own observation frames and are not a frame-invariant cross-run revision metric.
statistics: Per-run descriptive median/p95/range, three independent trials per condition; no formal inference or estimated population failure probability. Historical references excluded from new-condition counts.
